summary: Webhook health degraded: the forwarder process is gone while the receiver is up

options.description: Operator restarts the forwarder or re-registers the hook
Stay poll-only and accept the gh call rate

body: Webhook health is degraded: the forwarder process is gone while the receiver is up. Signals: {"receiver":true,"port":true,"lastEventAgeMin":0,"prActivityWithoutEvent":false,"prActivity":true,"quiet":false,"forwarder":"dead","feed":"gh-forward"}. Dispatch keeps working by polling gh (about 2,700 calls an hour), which is the rate-limit pressure. Fix (operator only; it touches your GitHub account and network): restart the feed with `gh webhook forward --repo <owner>/<repo> --events pull_request,check_suite,check_run,workflow_run,status,pull_request_review --url http://127.0.0.1:8765/webhooks/github` and record it with `cli-hierarchy webhook up --feed gh-forward`, or re-register the repository hook (secret equal to AI_SDLC_WEBHOOK_SECRET). If the receiver itself is down run `cli-hierarchy webhook up`. Episode since 2026-11-06T18:56:40.438Z.
